title: From Data to Valves: A Self-Learning, Production-Grade Edge Stack for Sustainable HVAC Control
abstract: arXiv:2611.24052v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learned HVAC controllers rarely leave the simulator, and those that do are typically trained offline, frozen at deployment and retrained from the cloud. We present a production stack in which three learning components run on one NVIDIA Jetson Orin gateway per building, adapt continuously from the building's own data, and verify their own effect. (a) A compact transformer-encoder forecaster, one per equipment group with learned per-unit embeddings, predicts every air-side unit's next-cycle temperature and learns prequentially, one gradient step per five-minute cycle, behind five independent gates that bound the influence of any corrupt reading. (b) A distributional soft actor-critic agent, one shared policy across unit types, converts the measured state into a chilled-water valve position under a structural safety envelope that no learned component can soften; its second generation learns nightly on the device from recorded transitions

translated_title: 从数据到阀门：面向可持续暖通空调（HVAC）控制的自学习生产级边缘技术栈
translated_abstract: 学习型HVAC控制器很少能真正走出模拟器，而那些实际部署的控制器通常采用离线训练、部署后冻结参数、并依赖云端重新训练的模式。我们提出了一个生产级技术栈，其中三个学习组件运行在每栋建筑的一台NVIDIA Jetson Orin网关上，从建筑自身数据持续自适应，并验证自身效果。(a) 一个紧凑的transformer编码器预测器，每个设备组配有一个并带有学习得到的每机组嵌入，用于预测每个空气侧机组的下一周期温度；它以序贯方式学习，每个五分钟周期执行一次梯度更新，并处于五个独立门控的约束之下，以限制任何损坏读数的影响。(b) 一个分布式软演员-评论家智能体，在不同机组类型之间共享同一策略，在一个学习组件无法削弱的结构性安全包络之下，将测量状态转换为冷冻水阀门位置；其第二代系统利用记录的状态转移数据在设备上每夜学习。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个在每栋建筑的NVIDIA Jetson Orin边缘网关上运行的自学习生产级HVAC控制栈，其核心创新是结合序贯学习且受多重门控保护的transformer温度预测器和带有不可削弱结构性安全包络的分布式软演员-评论家冷冻水阀门控制智能体，实现从建筑自身数据持续自适应并自我验证控制效果。
en_tdlr: A production-grade self-learning edge stack for HVAC control that runs a prequentially-updated, gate-protected transformer temperature forecaster and a distributional soft actor-critic chilled-water valve agent under an inviolable structural safety envelope on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin gateway per building, enabling continuous on-device adaptation and self-verification from the building's own data.
